test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Vikas starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops Point P.

What is the distance between Point A and Point P? (All turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
**Given:** All turns are 90° turns only

Vikas starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 12 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65374afdb15ddc691c90de1b75977ce4f32e6ea4a84321c9b34c573a842974b6.png] 

Thus, the distance between Point A and Point P is (5 Km - 3 km) = 2 km.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
